definition: The smallest tolerance at which the TRUE configuration still explains the real data is exactly max_r |d_estimated(r) - d_exact(r)| on the shared leaf set: the L-infinity residual.  It is reported with the median residual and both relative to the median observed distance, so it can be placed on the same axis as Theta_k.
note: residual_*_rel keeps stage 296's denominator (the exact partner's median observed distance); residual_*_rel_own uses the case's own median observed distance, which is the only denominator available for the travellers' samples, so the two collections can share an axis.
